bio.text: Matt Brown is serving his second term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 55, which includes a portion of Conway in Faulkner County.
He is an attorney practicing in Conway, a 2004 graduate of Hendrix College and a 2007 graduate of the William H. Bowen School of Law.
He previously served as a Justice of the Peace for Faulkner County and lives in Conway with his wife and two daughters.
